purpose: Freeze a one-attempt, order-preserving, result-free local embedding transport for the two Mem-Gallery dense controls before any real embedding service, dataset vector, prediction, or score is observed.
scientific_boundary: This artifact validates transport and accounting invariants on synthetic responses. It estimates no retrieval or answer quality and authorizes no numerical baseline result.

transport_contract.response_order: The response must contain exactly the requested item count with consecutive indices 0..N-1 in request order.
transport_contract.vector_validation: Every vector must have the method-bound exact dimension, contain only finite numeric non-boolean values, and have a finite nonzero L2 norm.
transport_contract.usage_validation: prompt_tokens and total_tokens are required nonnegative integers; completion_tokens may be omitted but is interpreted as zero, must equal zero if present, and prompt_tokens must equal total_tokens.
transport_contract.normalization: Returned vectors are preserved. The already frozen retrieval core computes cosine similarity and performs its own norm handling.

failure_contract.preflight: The entire text surface and batch size are validated before the first multi-batch call.
failure_contract.single_batch: Any HTTP, JSON, identity, count, order, dimension, numeric, norm, usage, byte-ceiling, or clock failure raises one EndpointCallError with one FAILED call record.
failure_contract.multi_batch: Stop at the first failed batch without retry and raise EmbeddingBatchError retaining every prior ACCEPTED call record, the FAILED record, and only the already returned partial vectors.

covered_invariants: full-surface validation before the first request
response model, count, index, dimension, numeric, finite, and nonzero-norm rejection
embedding usage accounting with zero completion tokens
method, input, seed, role, batch, and loopback endpoint rejection
no raw text in durable call records

next_gate: After WMA Wave 1 is terminal-released, accept the exact Mem-Gallery dataset and both method-bound model inventories, then freeze separate real service receipts and a fresh-root lifecycle successor that persists these call records alongside document/query vector identities.
authorization: This mock-only artifact authorizes no real dataset read, model load, endpoint service, embedding call, prediction, scoring, table admission, SOTA claim, or cleanup.
explicitly_prohibited: substituting the protected Qwen encoder for the method-prescribed GME encoder in naive-rag
substituting GME or another encoder for the protected Qwen encoder in hybrid-rag
accepting reordered, truncated, padded, zero, non-finite, or dimension-drifted vectors
retrying a failed batch automatically or discarding the failed call record
persisting raw input text in the call-accounting record
treating synthetic response validation as a reproduced baseline result
